## Claims
- [unsupported] The required explicit identities for \(\rho=(2,2)\) and \(\rho=(3,3)\) have not been obtained from the supplied material.
- [proved] The required \(\rho=(3,3)\) target has sign \(\bar s_{555}-\bar s_{33333}\), since \(|(3,3)|=6\).

## Strategy
Let \(A=\Lambda/I_{5,5}\) and
\[
J=\bigoplus_{333\subseteq\lambda\subseteq5^5}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda,\quad
L_\rho=\bar s_{(333,\rho)},\quad
R_{\rho'}=\bar s_{(3+\rho'_1,3+\rho'_2,3+\rho'_3)}.
\]
The prior draft lacks the two identities
\[
\bar s_{553}-\bar s_{33322}\in A_+J,\qquad
\bar s_{555}-\bar s_{33333}\in A_+J.
\]
Its attempted computation failed before producing integral certificates, specifically on \(\rho=(3,2)\); therefore it cannot certify any purported complete matrix witness.

## Gaps
The requested all-\(\rho\) integral certificate is not established. In particular, \((2,2)\) must be removed from the prior claim, and no assertion is made for \((3,3)\) beyond the corrected sign.

## Next
Obtain a successful exact Pieri-matrix witness or explicit expansions for the two missing differences.
